test_title: PYST 12: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 07 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The company experienced a significant drop in sales; __consequently__, it had to lay off several employees.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (accordingly)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"accordingly"** means in a way that is appropriate to the particular circumstances; as a result or consequence. (तदनुसार, परिणामस्वरूप)

 
 
• **Example:** She studied diligently for the exams and accordingly achieved excellent results.
 
 
 
• The given sentence discusses the company's actions (laying off employees) as a result of a significant drop in sales. The word "accordingly" perfectly fits the context, implying a cause-and-effect relationship. (तदनुसार)
 
 
• **Example:** The project was delayed, and accordingly, the launch date was postponed.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word to replace the underlined segment is **"accordingly."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (accordingly)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Naturally** (स्वाभाविक रूप से): In a way that is expected or normal.

 
 
• **Example:** Naturally, she was upset when she heard the bad news.
 

 
**Note:** "Naturally" does not fit the context of cause and effect in the given sentence.

 
 
• **Option 3: Superficially** (ऊपरी तौर पर): In a way that is only on the surface or not deeply considered.
 
 
• **Example:** The changes to the system were only superficially effective.
 

 
**Note:** This word does not fit the logical context of the sentence.

 
 
• **Option 4: Genuinely** (ईमानदारी से): Truly or sincerely.
 
 
• **Example:** She was genuinely excited about her promotion.
 

 
**Note:** This word does not convey the cause-and-effect relationship in the sentence.

 

35:Td42,

The correct answer is: **Option 1 (To reveal a secret)**.
